newsitem.title: USA: ITT says directories unit set for growth.
newsitem.headline: ITT says directories unit set for growth.

text.p: ITT Corp said it expects the world telephone directories business to pursue geographic and product growth after it becomes a new company.

"Our capacity to operate competitively internationally gives us confidence to continue growing our business in new geographic areas throughout the world. This international platform may also offer significant opportunities to market additional products and services," said ITT senior vice president Gerald Crotty, who will become chief executive of the highly-profitable directories business.
Crotty made his remarks in a conference call with analysts.

Under a massive restructuring announced earlier, ITT will break into three separate companies, one of which will be the directories busines. Privately-held investment firm Clayton, Dublier & Rice Inc will hold a minority stake in the new company, which will be named ITT Corp.
